title: #235 Local Museum
prompt: Quite a few people would first visit the local museums when they travel to new places. Discuss the reasons why people like to visit museums.

promptSegments.text: Quite a few people would first visit the local museums when they travel to new places.
Discuss the reasons why people like to visit museums.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Local museums are important places that help people learn about their area's past.

angles.en: Museums help people feel connected to their community.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph focuses on the educational value of local museums, explaining how they teach people about the past using physical items.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph focuses on the educational value of local museums, explaining how they teach people about the past using physical items.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph focuses on the cultural and emotional value, explaining how museums build a sense of local identity and pride.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph focuses on the cultural and emotional value, explaining how museums build a sense of local identity and pride.

angles.en: The first body paragraph focuses on the role of local museums in building and maintaining a sense of local identity and preserving collective memory.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph emphasizes the educational function of local museums, highlighting their ability to provide interactive learning experiences for diverse age groups.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph emphasizes the educational function of local museums, highlighting their ability to provide interactive learning experiences for diverse age groups.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

keyArguments: Museums provide a window into the cultural heritage of a place.
